Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class CallableSpec

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.CallableSpec
public final class CallableSpec extends Object
A stored-procedure or function call, described independently of any JDBC connection: the routine name, whether it returns a value, and its parameters in declaration order. The class renders the JDBC escape syntax — {call proc(?, ?)} for a procedure, {? = call fn(?)} for a function — which every driver understands, so no dialect-specific EXEC / CALL spelling is needed.

Being pure it is fully unit-testable: sql() and inputs() can be checked without a database, and JdbcService.call(com.nexuslink.protocol.db.CallableSpec) simply binds what this class describes.
